items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: We had Bud Scott, Buster Wilson, Eddie Gawne and myself.

ctx.x: He didn't know him. He played the Robichaux down there. That's right.
I met Bud out here, Bud John O'Reilly's band. And at one time, I wouldn't brag about it, but I think we had one of the best. We had Bud Scott, Buster Wilson, Eddie Gawne and myself.
It was a wonderful, that's the best good in the next night I've ever heard from the person.
